title: Learning the Shared Latent Structure of Cryo-EM Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding biomolecular function requires characterizing three-dimensional structure and conformational variability, for which cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) is a powerful tool. Cryo-EM produces noisy two-dimensional particle images in which molecular structure, particle pose, and imaging conditions are jointly encoded. Recovering biological information from these observations spans inverse problems including pose estimation, heterogeneity analysis, and reconstruction. These tasks are usually addressed independently despite shared protein structure and image formation, motivating a common representation across inverse problems. Since biologically meaningful differences may be spatially localized, we study self-distillation with complementary global and masked patch objectives. translated_title: 学习冷冻电镜逆问题的共享潜在结构
translated_abstract: 理解生物分子的功能需要表征其三维结构和构象变化，而冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）是实现这一目标的有力工具。冷冻电镜产生含噪声的二维颗粒图像，其中分子结构、颗粒姿态和成像条件被共同编码其中。从这些观测数据中恢复生物信息涉及多个逆问题，包括姿态估计、异质性分析和三维重构。尽管这些问题共享相同的蛋白质结构和图像成像过程，但它们通常被独立处理，这激发了研究跨逆问题的通用表征的需求。由于具有生物学意义的差异可能在空间上局部化，我们研究了采用互补的全局目标与掩码图像块目标的自蒸馏方法。此外，由于在实验数据集上进行区分可能反映的是采集过程特有的线索，我们开发了受控的合成数据与真实实验数据的评估方法……
tldr: 该论文提出通过结合全局目标与掩码图像块目标的互补自蒸馏方法，学习冷冻电镜各逆问题（姿态估计、异质性分析和重构）之间共享的潜在结构表征，以统一的表示提升多个冷冻电镜分析任务。
en_tdlr: This paper learns a shared latent structure representation across cryo-EM inverse problems (pose estimation, heterogeneity analysis, and reconstruction) via self-distillation with complementary global and masked patch objectives, enabling a unified representation to benefit multiple cryo-EM analysis tasks.
